name: Eonvelope Self-Hosted Email Archive
free_limit: Free AGPL-3.0-or-later self-hosted email archiving software; no software seat, storage, or time quota stated. Supports IMAP, POP, Exchange and JMAP fetching, search, import and export.
watch_out: Bring your own server, persistent storage, and mail accounts; infrastructure and email provider charges are not included. AGPL-3.0-or-later obligations apply to modified network deployments. Primary development is on GitLab; GitHub is a read-only mirror. Assess retention, backup, privacy and production reliability independently.
